title: Anth.us Papyrus: canonical /articles/ directory URLs + 301s from legacy shapes
description:
Canonical URL namespace for the Anth.us Papyrus port: `/articles/` directory-style, with real 301s from every legacy Gatsby URL shape.

## Why
Ryan: "We really want to use /articles/ but we need to support redirects from /blog/ for backward compatibility with articles already published." `/articles/` is canonical going forward; legacy published URLs must 301 onto it.

## Where
- Repo: `/Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-Papyrus` (no worktree; work was done in the main checkout)
- Branch: `feature/canonical-articles-urls`, based on `feature/anthus-papyrus-port`
- Commit: `3e50a49`
- PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus/pull/3 (base `feature/anthus-papyrus-port`)
- Staging Amplify app: `d2hbn1ig6nqyhy` / `anthus-papyrus-staging`, branch `staging`, us-east-1, AWS_PROFILE=legacy, https://staging.d2hbn1ig6nqyhy.amplifyapp.com

## DONE and verified (locally)
- New module `web/anthus_urls.py` owns the URL shape as a SINGLE configuration point: `page_url()` (canonical URL), `page_output()` (where the HTML is written), `URL_STYLE` from env `ANTHUS_URL_STYLE` (`directory` default, `html` restores the old extension style across pages, links, canonical tags, sitemap and all redirect targets).
- Papyrus still renders `articles/<slug>.html`; `relocate_pages()` in `build_via_papyrus.py` moves each file to `articles/<slug>/index.html` afterwards. 179 of 185 pages relocate (the 6 that do not are `404.html` plus the five `index.html` files).
- Link rewriting rewritten: one pass over rendered HTML, now resolving RELATIVE references too (required — moving a page into its own directory otherwise points `../css/site-theme.css` at `/articles/css/site-theme.css`).
- Meta-refresh stubs (~120, previously emitted under `/blog/`) REMOVED. Replaced by 134 Amplify `customRules` with status 301, generated by the build into `web/custom-rules.json`.
- `bin/apply_custom_rules.py` pushes the rules via `aws amplify update-app`; refuses any app but `d2hbn1ig6nqyhy`/`anthus-papyrus-staging`.
- Local verification evidence:
  - build: `185 pages, 134 redirect rules, 179 page(s) relocated`
  - internal refs: 3950 examined, 431 distinct targets, 3935 resolve on disk, 0 land on a redirect rule source, 0 pages with double-escaped entities
  - the only 15 non-resolving refs are the 3 known pre-existing content bugs, left BYTE-IDENTICAL and reported: `/engage` (12), `/solutions/sqlbot` (2), scheme-less `arxiv.org` (1)
  - rules validated: all 134 targets exist in dist, 0 self-referential, 0 duplicate sources, 0 targets that are themselves a rule source (no chains/loops)
  - coverage simulated over all 254 URLs in production's live `sitemap-0.xml`: 17 already canonical (200, no rule), 231 301 to an existing page, 2 301 to a missing target, 4 with no rule
- Staging guards confirmed intact in the new build: per-page `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">`, `robots.txt` = `Disallow: /`, and `X-Robots-Tag` still on the app's `customHeaders` (untouched).

## NOT DONE — next steps, in order
1. Get Ryan's answer on directory-style vs `.html` (separate issue, blocking-ish but cheap to flip).
2. Build for deploy WITH the origin env var, or canonical/og:url ship as `http://localhost:8080`:
   `cd /Users/home/Projects/Anth.us-Papyrus && rm -rf web/dist-papyrus web/staging && ANTHUS_SITE_ORIGIN=https://staging.d2hbn1ig6nqyhy.amplifyapp.com PAPYRUS_ROOT=/Users/home/Projects/Papyrus python3 web/build_via_papyrus.py`
   (this build was already produced and spot-checked: canonical came out as `https://staging.d2hbn1ig6nqyhy.amplifyapp.com/articles/can-you-fix-it/`)
3. Manual deploy (the app has NO repo connection, so there is no CI build): zip `web/dist-papyrus`, `aws amplify create-deployment` -> upload to `zipUploadUrl` -> `start-deployment` -> poll `get-job`. Full runbook is in `AGENTS.md` under "Deploy".
4. Apply the rules — a SEPARATE step from the deploy, because `customRules` is app config and not part of the artifact:
   `AWS_PROFILE=legacy python3 bin/apply_custom_rules.py` (dry run) then `--apply`.
5. Live-verify on https://staging.d2hbn1ig6nqyhy.amplifyapp.com: canonical URLs 200, every legacy shape 301 to the right target, no loops, `/robots.txt` still Disallow, `X-Robots-Tag` still present, and the 3 content bugs still broken.

## NOT VERIFIED
Nothing has been deployed and no rule has been applied. The staging host is still serving the PREVIOUS `.html`-style build (`/articles/can-you-fix-it.html` returns 200 live right now). The 134 rules have never been exercised as a set against the real host — only the rule SEMANTICS were measured with small probe sets (see gotchas).

## Gotchas / things that cost time
- The Amplify app was left CLEAN: `customRules` is back to just `[{source:/<*>, target:/404.html, status:404}]`. All probe rules were removed. Verify this before assuming anything.
- The content submodule checkout at `content/anthus-site-content` was switched from `ab15f2b` (the PR #2 pin) to `71c1158` (this branch's pin) with `git submodule update --init --recursive`. If you switch back to `feature/markus-native-content-and-citations`, re-run that command or the build fails with `Unknown directive 'image'`.
- Production content is AHEAD of the submodule pin. Two sitemap URLs 301 to targets that do not exist in this build (`/blog/null/` -> `/articles/null/`, `/posts/page/5/` -> `/posts/page-5/`). Both rule groups are generated from the corpus, so both self-correct on a submodule bump. Not rule bugs.
- `write_redirects` is gone; `print(f"... {redirects} redirect stubs")` became "redirect rules". That one line is context in PR #2's last hunk, so expect a trivial one-line conflict there.
